limits: Green symbol panels distinguish covered Western unit types from normal Soviet panels; nationality backgrounds are unchanged.
Nine symbol types are covered: infantry, armor, airborne, artillery, anti-tank, anti-aircraft, ordinary HQs, engineers and railway units.
Army/corps/army-group command TOEs use HQ. Ordinary engineers/construction use engineer symbols; railway TOEs retain rail symbols.
Other specialized types, preassigned custom symbols, amphibious HQs and airbases retain their original symbols.
At the smallest9x9 zoom the game atlas has no symbol artwork; no distinction is promised at that zoom.
Offline sprite and scenario verification only; visual in-game display not yet verified.
